claims.statement: Actor, UDI/device, notified-body and certificate, and market-surveillance EUDAMED modules became mandatory on 28 May 2026; vigilance and clinical-investigation modules remain under development.
The Commission publishes EUDAMED machine-to-machine, public API and technical-onboarding resources, so bulk-data tooling has an official integration path.
Smaller operators have enough migration and data-quality pain to buy a specialized batch service instead of using the free portal or an existing consultant.

contrary_evidence: EUDAMED provides a free portal, user guides and onboarding materials.
Established regulatory consultants and quality-management vendors already serve manufacturers.
The remaining modules are not yet mandatory, so a broad all-module platform would be premature.

economics.acquisition_route: Reach manufacturers through Polish medtech clusters, notified-body and regulatory-consultant referrals, and public EUDAMED records; start with one narrow device class and one partner consultant.
economics.founder_time: Part-time validation hypothesis; delivery burden remains untested.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A tested mapping library for common source systems and device families can reduce migration time. Public records and rules are not proprietary, and confidential client data should remain segregated.
fingerprint.customer: Small Polish and CEE medical-device manufacturers, authorized representatives and importers with multiple devices or legacy records but no dedicated EUDAMED data team.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Reach manufacturers through Polish medtech clusters, notified-body and regulatory-consultant referrals, and public EUDAMED records; start with one narrow device class and one partner consultant.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Clean and reconcile actor, Basic UDI-DI, UDI-DI, device, nomenclature and certificate fields, validate cross-record consistency, and prepare portal or machine-to-machine uploads with an audit trail. Pair the software with a qualified regulatory consultant for judgment calls.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The economic operator pays per batch of validated records and migration, then a maintenance fee for new devices and change monitoring. Payment occurs on delivery of a validated upload pack, not on a promise of regulatory approval.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: An actor, device, UDI or certificate record must be registered, migrated or corrected after mandatory EUDAMED use began, and spreadsheet or portal entry risks inconsistent identifiers and rejected records.

founder_fit: Health interest and medical access improve domain learning
Identifier reconciliation and bulk validation match data-science skills
Batch onboarding is measurable and can start as a part-time service
Consultant referral channels reduce continuous social selling
risks: Evidence of a workflow, transition, or loss does not yet establish recurring willingness to pay.
The proposed distribution and compounding mechanisms remain hypotheses pending buyer evidence.

title: EUDAMED UDI record QA and bulk-onboarding service
uncertainties: Number of addressable Polish and CEE operators and devices needing migration
Machine-to-machine access conditions for a third-party service provider
Typical rejection or correction causes and batch size
Required regulatory credentials, insurance and liability allocation
Pricing, buyer authority, and acquisition economics remain unvalidated at discovery.

First validation test: Use the public API and documentation to build a 20-record validation prototype, interview ten Polish manufacturers or authorized representatives through one regulatory partner, and sell one fixed-fee sandbox or controlled batch migration. Continue only if the client validates time saved and buys maintenance for subsequent records.
